extracted.intended_audience: Applicants to the Damon Runyon Fellowship Award (physician-scientists, postdoctoral/clinical fellows, early-career cancer researchers)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and required materials for preparing and submitting a Damon Runyon Fellowship Award application, including eligibility rules, required documents, formatting limits, and sponsor/applicant responsibilities. Targeted at prospective applicants and their Sponsors/co-Sponsors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission method and deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Application must be submitted through Proposal Central by 4:00 PM Eastern Time on August 14, 2026. No hard copies or emailed applications will be accepted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications open and due dates listed on Proposal Central; applicants must follow Proposal Central submission workflow. (Also notes other deadline dates for different review cycles.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference letters required (quantity, source, length)
rubrics_metrics.description: Three letters of reference are required from qualified individuals, other than the candidate's Sponsor, who can evaluate the candidate's qualifications and assess potential for independent cancer research. For candidates with a PhD, one reference must come from the thesis advisor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reference letters should be two to three pages in length. In Section 7 applicants enter referees' email addresses; referees receive an email from Proposal Central and upload letters via the portal.

rubrics_metrics.name: All reference letters must be submitted before application submission
rubrics_metrics.description: All three reference letters must be submitted on or before the application deadline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants will NOT be able to submit their application unless all reference letters are uploaded to the portal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application cover sheet and signatures
rubrics_metrics.description: Application cover sheet (including demographic survey) with all required signatures (electronic/scanned).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If applying under mentorship of two Sponsors, the second Sponsor must fill out the co-Sponsor cover sheet. Only one application will be accepted from a Sponsor, co-Sponsor, or Fellow per review session.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsor's biosketch (NIH format)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sponsor’s biosketch must be provided in NIH format (SAMPLE).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If applying under mentorship of two Sponsors, the co-Sponsor must also submit a biosketch. Note: For the March 16, 2026 deadline the old NIH word template will be accepted; format requirements for other deadlines may change—check guidelines or contact awards@damonrunyon.org.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsor's letter of support
rubrics_metrics.description: Sponsor’s letter of support evaluating the candidate’s qualifications for the proposed research project and an assessment of the candidate’s potential for successful independent cancer research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If applying under mentorship of two Sponsors, one letter should be written jointly by both sponsors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsor's comprehensive and detailed training plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Sponsor must submit a comprehensive and detailed training plan for the candidate, up to two pages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If applying under mentorship of two Sponsors, one training plan for the candidate must be written jointly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsor's mentorship track record
rubrics_metrics.description: Sponsor must provide mentorship track record with names and current positions of graduate and postdoctoral trainees from the past 10 years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If applying under mentorship of two Sponsors, the co-Sponsor must also submit a separate mentorship track record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant's biosketch (NIH non-fellowship format)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant’s biosketch must be in NIH format (non-fellowship) (SAMPLE).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For the March 16, 2026 deadline the old NIH word template will be accepted; format requirements for later deadlines may change—check guidelines or contact awards@damonrunyon.org.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant's Research Support Form (if applicable)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant must include a Research Support Form if applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide complete and accurate information about current and pending support per the form's instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant's bibliography with hyperlinks
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant's bibliography must be a separate list with hyperlinks to each publication (in addition to the NIH Biosketch).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You may include hyperlinks to preprints on bioRxiv.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant's letter (approx. two pages) content
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant's letter, approximately two pages, must include: description of previous research and teaching experience; statement on the transformative impact they had on their field of research as a graduate student; if training at same institution where degree was received, an explanation of the reason(s) for remaining at the same institution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The explanation for staying at the same institution can be copied from page 2 of the cover sheet. Note: Proposals to continue training in the laboratory where the applicant received their PhD will not be considered; proposals that are direct extensions of graduate work will not be funded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant's personal statement (one page)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant's personal statement: a one page narrative including what they anticipate gaining from this award with respect to its impact and their career development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Optional: may include personal background (experiences that influenced educational and career goals or challenges faced while pursuing research careers).

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of long-term commitment to cancer research
rubrics_metrics.description: Statement of applicant's long-term commitment to a career in cancer research, no longer than one paragraph indicating what the applicant plans to do after completing their postdoc.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research proposal page/format limits and required elements
rubrics_metrics.description: Research proposal including figures and/or tables incorporated into the text, not to exceed five pages of single-spaced, 12-point type with at least 0.5-inch margins.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In the proposal the applicant should: provide a summary of the research proposed (this is in addition to the required summary form); provide a brief background to the proposed research; state specific research objectives/aims; describe concisely the method of approach for the proposed research; explain the significance of the proposed research to the Fellowship's goals (understanding the causes and mechanisms of cancer and developing more effective cancer therapies and prevention); demonstrate the relevance of their own background and the background and previous work of the Sponsor and any other investigators to the proposed research; list references including the full title of each work cited—references are not included in the five-page limit.

rubrics_metrics.name: References formatting for proposal
rubrics_metrics.description: List references including the full title of each work cited.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References are not included in the five-page limit for the research proposal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diploma or proof of degree conferral
rubrics_metrics.description: Copy of the applicant's diploma must be provided. Applicants who have not yet received their PhD diploma but have successfully completed all PhD requirements, including PhD defense, may submit a letter from their graduate school explicitly stating such, with the dates of the PhD defense and degree conferral.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a copy of diploma to confirm date of conferral where requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Summary of Research Form (abstract)
rubrics_metrics.description: Summary of Research Form, not to exceed one page (Same as Abstract, copy and paste).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This one-page summary is a required filed element in addition to the research proposal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaboration letters (if applicable)
rubrics_metrics.description: If applicable, up to two letters from collaborators, not to exceed one page, indicating their willingness to contribute equipment, materials, or expertise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These letters should be a brief description of the collaboration, not an evaluation of the candidate (NOT REFERENCE LETTERS).

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility timing for Level 2 Candidates (Board Eligible Physician-Scientists)
rubrics_metrics.description: Level 2 Candidates may apply at any time prior to their initial assistant professorship appointment (or equivalent); postdoctoral fellows, clinical fellows, and clinical instructors are eligible to apply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a copy of diploma as proof of conferral where required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limit on number of applications per sponsor/co-sponsor/fellow
rubrics_metrics.description: Only one application will be accepted from a Sponsor, co-Sponsor, or Fellow per review session.
